name_title: Rolex GMT-Master II Batman on Suited Wrist
description: A luxury watch with a black dial and blue/black bezel on a stainless steel bracelet is worn on a man's wrist. The man is wearing a dark navy blue pinstripe suit with a white dress shirt. The watch appears to be a Rolex GMT-Master II 'Batman', a high-end Swiss timepiece known for its dual-timezone functionality.
